adjudication.basis: A KG-grounded entity/event recommendation method satisfies the explicit guidance alternative. It ranks actual EventKG events for a user-selected topic and language, motivating within-language/cross-language discovery. Requiring a deployed iterative GUI would narrow the frozen OR test and conflict with QBEES treatment.

codes.notes: LaSER implements entity-seeded language-context recommendations; language conditioning is explicit, individual personalization is not established. Graph serialization/storage unspecified. Annotation judgments are not exploration-time or sensemaking effects.

LaSER is a KG-based event-recommendation algorithm with human relevance judgements and hypothetical exploratory applications. The judgement interface is not an evaluated iterative KG explorer; scope adjudication is needed for whether such recommendation components meet the minimum interaction criterion.

report_level_evaluation.design: Recommendation relevance annotation, plus offline ranking/candidate experiments
report_level_evaluation.comparators: Milne-Witten/DeepWalk for user relevance; additional Node2Vec/SuperGAT offline
report_level_evaluation.results: Language-specific MAP@5 .81 German,.90 French,.84 Russian; topic relevance slightly below baselines. These are ranking judgments, not time/sensemaking benefit.
